# Loads the PMM 0001 file tests/fixtures/rust/pmm1/v1_scene.pmm and saves it as 0002.
# The loader cannot open the accessories cube.x and sphere.x by the relative
# paths the file names, shows two boxes each, and asks for the files.

load pmm v1_scene.pmm
